## Diagnostic Decision Principle

Amplitude, morphology, centroid, map, support/learning, and noise diagnostics
measure different properties. The future author must preserve them as separate
quantities unless a scientific derivation proves a relationship for an exact
method and validity domain. A stop rule must say how disagreements,
non-finite/unavailable values, measurement-limited trajectories, persistence,
maximum limits, and source class are handled.

## Terminal Claim Principle

“Completed,” “maximum reached,” “converged,” “selected terminal,” and “valid for
a named downstream use” are five separate claims. Each needs its own realized
state and failure meaning.
